title: TRINITY frozen chart evidence validation
summary: Verify every archived electronic stencil member and require a source-checked DVR diagnostic for each declared large-amplitude mode.
gates: An electronic stencil archive and its external manifest must be supplied together; empty evidence is rejected
Archive SHA256, embedded manifest, exact member list, member sizes and member SHA256 values must match
Every declared large-amplitude mode requires a passing DVR diagnostic for the same one-based mode
Every DVR diagnostic source file must match its recorded SHA256
coordinate_policy: Validate chart evidence without changing the frozen ESALC-C or ESALC-I coordinate definitions. Mode numbers in KeyMaker are one-based and converted to zero-based diagnostic indices.
backend_policy: Read only saved electronic and DVR evidence; never launch a QM backend during validation.
